hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Convert consecutive pairs in nums into a difference code: 1 if nums[i+1] > nums[i], 0 if equal, and -1 if nums[i+1] < nums[i].

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: This produces an array diff of length n - 1.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Count all contiguous subarrays of diff of length m that match pattern.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sign conversion followed by sliding window comparison.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sign mapping simplifies pairwise checks to array comparison.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary list for sign differences.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Map adjacent element differences to {-1, 0, 1} pattern domain.
